QUOTE: With assembly it is `asm volatile("" : [x] "+r"(x))`, an empty statement that forces `x` into a register and claims it was modified.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the empty asm volatile with "+r" input-output operand, which emits no instruction and serves to make the value opaque to the compiler, i.e. an optimisation barrier.
